=== .gitlab-ci.yml (stages-yaml)
# Imported from .gitlab-ci.yml by launchway import pipeline. The old files are untouched.
# Read the findings it printed: lines marked NEEDS A PERSON below are not converted.
pipeline: ci
on:
  push: {branches: ['*'], tags: ['*']}
steps:
  slow:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    retry: 2
    run: |
      sleep 1
  child:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    needs: slow
    run: |
      echo 'NEEDS A PERSON: this job started another pipeline'; exit 1
  stop:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    needs: slow
    when: {upstream: always}
    run: |
      echo stop
